body.statement: For every \(p,p'\in\mathcal P_0\), \(|G(p)-G(p')|\le L_{\rm lip}\lVert p-p'\rVert_{\infty}\).
body.justification: A global certificate transfers continuum coverage through a finite rational grid, including the origin.
body.gap: General exact multinomial-function inversion assumes continuity but does not give a usable global constant for this inverse-normal composition.
body.consumer: Auditable software can bound off-grid error without floating-point sampling of derivatives near zero.
